Rashi on Yevamot 32a:11:1.hebrew: מיתלא תלי - דאי הוה פקע איסור אשת אח, הוה חייל איסור אחות אשה, דהאי דלא חייל מעיקרא משום טעמא דאיסור אשת אח דהוה קאי קמיה. הלכך, הואיל ואיסור אחות אשה מוכן ועומד לחול עליה, פטורה מן היבם, לא פקע איסור אשת אח וחייב משום אשת אח:
Rashi on Yevamot 32a:11:1.english: Remains suspended - For if the prohibition of a brother's wife were to be terminated, the prohibition of a wife's sister would take effect, as the reason it did not take effect originally [was] because of the prohibition of a brother's wife that stood before it. Therefore, since the prohibition of a wife's sister is ready and standing to take effect upon her, she is exempt from the yavam [levirate brother-in-law]; [thus,] the prohibition of a brother's wife does not terminate, and he is liable on account of a brother's wife.

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:12:1.hebrew: שתי מיתות - כגון חמותו והיא אשת איש, דאחמותו שריפה ואאשת איש חנק:
Rashi on Yevamot 32a:12:1.english: Two death penalties - For example, his mother-in-law who is [also] a married woman, as for his mother-in-law [the penalty is] burning, and for a married woman [it is] strangulation.

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:12:2.english: Is sentenced to the harsher [death] - By burning.

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:13:1.english: His mother-in-law and she became a married woman - For she was a widow when he married her daughter.

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:13:2.hebrew: נידון באשת איש - ואע"ג דקיל הוא. אלמא, לא אתי איסור חמותו וחייל אאשת איש, דאי חיילי תרוייהו עליה, הוה לן למדייניה בחמורה:
Rashi on Yevamot 32a:13:2.english: He is sentenced for [violating the prohibition of] a married woman - Even though it is [the] more lenient [prohibition]. Thus, the prohibition of his mother-in-law does not come and take effect upon [the prohibition of] a married woman, for if both of them took effect upon him, we would have to sentence him with the more severe [penalty].

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:1:1.hebrew: ומקצתו חלוץ - ואתי למימר בב' יבמות הבאות מבית אחד, חדא מתייבמת ואחרת חלצה:
Rashi on Yevamot 32a:1:1.english: And part of it [must be] released by ḥalitza - And [this] comes to say [that] regarding two yevamot who come from one household, one enters into levirate marriage and the other performs ḥalitza.

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:4:1.hebrew: נתן גט למאמרו - אמתניתין קאי, שאם נתן זה העושה מאמר גט למאמרו ולא לזיקתו ואח"כ מת, הותרה אשתו הראשונה, שהיא צרתה, להתייבם לשלישי; דמאמר דעבד שקליה, ולאו צרות נינהו. והשתא לא אתי למימר בשתי יבמות מבית אחד חדא חלצה וחדא מייבמא, דהכא לאו מבית אחד מיחזי:
Rashi on Yevamot 32a:4:1.english: He gave a bill of divorce for his ma'amar [levirate betrothal] - This refers to the Mishnah: that if this [brother] who performed ma'amar gave a bill of divorce for his ma'amar and not for his levirate bond, and afterwards died, his first wife — who is her rival wife — is permitted to enter into levirate marriage with the third [brother], for he has removed the ma'amar that he made, and they are not rival wives [to each other]. And now one will not come to say [regarding] two yevamot from one house [that] one performs chalitzah and one enters into levirate marriage, for here they do not appear [to be] from one house.

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:4:2.hebrew: אבל היא אסורה - ולא משום דקם ליה בלא יבנה, דפוסלה על אחיו הנשאר, שהרי לא נתן גט לזיקה; אלא משום דאתי לאיחלופי בבעלת הגט, היכא דעבד גט למאמרו ולזיקתו, דההיא ודאי מידחיא. אבל גט למאמרו לא דחי אלא מאמר, ונשארה זיקה ראשונה במקומה:
Rashi on Yevamot 32a:4:2.english: However, she is forbidden - And not because he is subject to [the verse] "shall not build," which disqualifies her for his remaining brother, since he did not give a bill of divorce for the levirate bond; rather, because it might come to be confused with a woman who received a bill of divorce — where he gave a bill of divorce for his levirate betrothal and for his levirate bond, for that [woman] is certainly disqualified. However, a bill of divorce for his levirate betrothal only nullifies [the] levirate betrothal, and the original levirate bond remains in its place.

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:5:1.english: Even she is permitted - to the third [brother] when the second [brother] dies.

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:5:2.hebrew: מאי דעבד שקליה - והויא כמו שלא עשה בה מאמר, ואתיא ומתייבמת לשלישי מחמת זיקת אחיו הראשון. ודוקא שפירש למאמרו ולא לזיקתו קאמר, אבל סתמא קיימא בלא יבנה אכולהו אחין, והכי מוכחא מילתא דרבא בפרק רבן גמליאל (לקמן יבמות ד' נב:) דלמאמרו ולא לזיקתו קאמר:
Rashi on Yevamot 32a:5:2.english: That which he performed, he removed - And it is as though he had not performed levirate betrothal with her, and she comes and enters into levirate marriage with the third [brother] by virtue of the levirate bond of his first brother. And [Rava] states [this] specifically where he specified [that the bill of divorce was] for his levirate betrothal and not for his levirate bond; but [if he gave it] unspecified, she stands under [the prohibition of] "he shall not build" with respect to all the brothers. And so it is proven from Rava's statement in the chapter [entitled] Rabban Gamliel (below, Yevamot 52b), that he is speaking of [a case where he specified] for his levirate betrothal and not for his levirate bond.

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:7:1.hebrew: פשיטא השתא ומה התם דלא אידחיא מהאי ביתא - לעיל (יבמות דף ל.), גבי שלשה אחים, שנים מהם נשואים שתי אחיות ואחד נשא נכרית, ומת אחד מבעלי אחיות וכנס נשוי נכרית את אשתו, ומתה אשתו של שני, ואח"כ מת נשוי נכרית — הרי זו אסורה עליו עולמית משום אשת אח, הואיל ונאסרה עליו שעה אחת בנפילה ראשונה משום אחות אשה. ואע"ג דבההיא נפילה קמייתא לא אידחיא לה לגמרי, דהא קאי נשוי נכרית שזוקקה לייבום וקורא אני בה בשעת נפילה "יבמה יבא עליה", אפי' הכי חשבינן לה לגבי בעל אחותה כאשת אח שיש לה בנים, לאיתסורי עליה אפילו לאחר מיתת אחותה:
Rashi on Yevamot 32a:7:1.english: [Isn't it] obvious? Now, just as there, where she was not rejected from this household - Earlier (Yevamot 30a), regarding three brothers, two of whom were married to two sisters and one married an unrelated woman, and one of the husbands of the sisters died, and the one married to the unrelated woman took his wife [in levirate marriage], and the wife of the second [brother] died, and afterward the one married to the unrelated woman died — she is forbidden to him forever on account of [the prohibition of] a brother's wife, since she was forbidden to him for one moment at the first falling [for levirate marriage] on account of [being his] wife's sister. And even though at that first falling she was not completely rejected [from the household], for the one married to the unrelated woman was there, who binds her to levirate marriage, and I apply to her at the time of falling [the verse], "her brother-in-law shall cohabit with her" [Deuteronomy 25:5], nevertheless, with respect to her sister's husband, we consider her like a brother's wife who has children, to be forbidden to him even after her sister's death.

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:7:2.hebrew: הכא - דבשעת נפילה אידחיא מהאי ביתא לגמרי, דאין כאן אלא בעל אחותה, ומשעה שנפלה לפניו אין זיקת יבום עליה, מיבעיא:
Rashi on Yevamot 32a:7:2.english: Here - where at the time of falling [for levirate marriage] she was pushed away from this household completely, for there is no one here except her sister's husband, and from the moment she fell before him there is no levirate bond upon her, is it necessary [to state]?

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:7:3.hebrew: תנא הא - מתני' דהכא תנא ברישא:
Rashi on Yevamot 32a:7:3.english: The tanna [taught] this - [He] taught the Mishnah here first.

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:7:4.hebrew: והך - דשלשה אחים, דלא אידחיא מהאי ביתא לגמרי, חזיא מעיקרא להיתרא ושריא, [משום הכי לא תניא]:
Rashi on Yevamot 32a:7:4.english: And this [case] - of three brothers, where she was not completely rejected from this household, she was initially fit to be permitted and is permitted; [therefore he did not teach it].

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:7:5.hebrew: הדר חזיא לאיסורא - דמ"מ, לדידה לא קרינא ביה משעת נפילה "יבמה יבא עליה":
Rashi on Yevamot 32a:7:5.english: Then it reverted to the prohibition - For in any case, regarding her, we do not apply to him from the time of [her] falling [into levirate obligation the verse], "her brother-in-law shall consummate with her."

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:7:6.english: That it was beloved to him - Because it is a novelty.

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:7:7.hebrew: ומשנה הראשונה - שיתירה היא משנשנית זו, הואיל והיתה שנויה מתחלה:
Rashi on Yevamot 32a:7:7.english: And the first mishnah - which is superfluous once this [mishnah] was taught, since it was taught from the beginning:

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:7:8.english: Does not move from its place - [so as] to uproot it completely.

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:8:1.english: He engaged in intercourse with her - During his wife's lifetime.

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:8:2.hebrew: משום אשת אח - דהא רחמנא פטרה מייבום, וקמה עליה כמי שיש לו בנים:
Rashi on Yevamot 32a:8:2.english: For [the prohibition of] a brother's wife - For the Merciful One exempted her from levirate marriage, and she remains [prohibited] to him like [the wife of] one who has children.

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:8:3.english: Only for a brother's wife - As [the Gemara] establishes the reason later.

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:9:1.hebrew: נשא חי ואח"כ נשא מת - איסור אחות אשה קדים, דקודם שנשאה אחיו המת, היתה עומדת עליו באיסור אחות אשה:
Rashi on Yevamot 32a:9:1.english: The living [brother] married, and afterward the deceased [brother] married - The prohibition of a wife's sister came first, for before his deceased brother married her, she stood [forbidden] to him under the prohibition of a wife's sister.

Rashi on Yevamot 32a:9:2.hebrew: בנשא מת ואח"כ נשא חי - דאיסור אשת אח קדים, ותו לא אתי איסור אחות אשה וחייל עלה, דקסבר אין איסור חל על איסור:
Rashi on Yevamot 32a:9:2.english: Where the deceased [brother] married [first] and afterward the living [brother] married - For the prohibition of a brother's wife preceded [it], and the prohibition of a wife's sister does not then come and take effect upon her, for he holds [that] a prohibition does not take effect upon [an existing] prohibition.

Tosafot on Yevamot 32a:11:1.hebrew: לא פקע - ואע"ג דלא חייל איסור אחות אשה, אסורה נמי הצרה לייבומי כיון דלא פקע איסור אשת אח, כמו אילונית דאוסרת צרתה אע"ג דאין בה אלא איסור אשת אח לחודה. וא"ת: לר"ש משכחת לה אשת אח מן האב דפוטרת צרתה, וליחשבה בהדי ט"ו נשים בפ"ק (דף ב. ודף י.) למ"ד בפלוגתא קא מיירי, וכן האי דלעיל דקתני "נאסרה עליו עולמית", גם היא פוטרת צרתה, וליחשבה? וי"ל: דהני, כיון דמכח אחות אשה אסירא, בכלל אחות אשה נינהו:
Tosafot on Yevamot 32a:11:1.english: Is not terminated - And even though the prohibition of a wife's sister does not take effect, the co-wife is also forbidden for levirate marriage, since the prohibition of a brother's wife is not terminated — just like a sterile woman [aylonit], who forbids her co-wife even though she has only the prohibition of a brother's wife alone. And if you ask: According to Rabbi Shimon, you find [a case of] a paternal brother's wife who exempts her co-wife — so let [the Mishnah] count her among the fifteen women in the first chapter (2a and 10a) according to the one who says [that the Mishnah] is speaking [even] of disputed cases; and similarly, this [case] above where it taught, "she became forbidden to him forever," she too exempts her co-wife, so let [the Mishnah] count her! And one can answer: These, since they are forbidden by force of [the prohibition of] a wife's sister, are included in [the category of] a wife's sister.

Tosafot on Yevamot 32a:13:1.hebrew: ונעשית אשת איש נידון בחמותו - ואין זה מכח זיקה ראשונה, דבלאו הכי מי שנתחייב ב' מיתות נידון בחמורה:
Tosafot on Yevamot 32a:13:1.english: "And she became a married woman, he is sentenced for [violating the prohibition of] his mother-in-law" - And this is not by virtue of the first relationship [that applied to him], for even without this, one who becomes liable to two death penalties is sentenced to the more severe [one].

Tosafot on Yevamot 32a:5:1.hebrew: גט למאמרו כו' - הקשה ריב"ן: דתנן בפר"ג (לקמן יבמות דף נ.) דיש מאמר אחר מאמר, ואם עשה מאמר בזו ובזו, צריכה ב' גיטין וחליצה — בין יבם אחד לב' יבמות, בין ב' יבמין ליבמה אחת — אבל יבומי חד מינייהו לא! ולרבא, יתן גט למאמרו ולא לזיקתו, וליבומי אידך! ותירץ: דלכתחלה אין לעשות כן, דגזרינן גט למאמרו אטו גט לזיקתו. ודוקא בדיעבד קאמר הכא רבא דהותרה אפי' היא; דכיון דתו ליכא למיגזר בהאי מאמר אטו שאר מאמרות דעלמא — לא גזרינן, דלא שכיחי כולי האי, אבל לכתחלה גזרינן משום האי מאמר גופיה:
Tosafot on Yevamot 32a:5:1.english: [If he gave] a bill of divorce for his ma'amar, etc. - Rivan raised a difficulty: For we learned in a Mishnah in the chapter [entitled] Rabban Gamliel (below, Yevamot 50a) that there is [validity to a] ma'amar [levirate betrothal] after ma'amar, and if one performed ma'amar with this one and with that one, she requires two bills of divorce and chalitzah — whether [it is a case of] one yavam with two yevamot [or] two yevamim with one yevamah — but to perform yibbum with one of them, [they may] not! Yet according to Rava, let him give a bill of divorce for his ma'amar and not for his zikah [levirate bond], and let [him or the other brother] perform yibbum with the other! And he answered: Ab initio one may not do so, because we decree [prohibiting] a bill of divorce for his ma'amar on account of a bill of divorce for his zikah. And it is specifically post facto that Rava says here that even she is permitted; for since there is no longer [reason] to make a decree regarding this ma'amar on account of other ma'amarot in general — we do not make a decree, because they are not so common — whereas ab initio we do make a decree on account of this ma'amar itself.

Tosafot on Yevamot 32a:7:1.hebrew: דאידחיא מהאי ביתא לגמרי לא כ"ש - אע"ג דמהאי בבא שמעינן דאסירא אע"ג דאיחזיא בהך נפילה, דלא שמעינן מבבא דלעיל כדאמר לעיל (יבמות דף ל.), מ"מ כיון דאידחיא מהאי ביתא לגמרי, פשיטא דאסירא אע"ג דחזיא בהא נפילה. ולעיל דקאמר טעמא דאיחזיא בהך נפילה אהאי מתניתין, משום דאכתי לא אסיק אדעתיה טעמא דאידחיא מהאי ביתא:
Tosafot on Yevamot 32a:7:1.english: Where she is disassociated from this household completely, [is it] not all the more so? - Even though from this clause [of the Mishnah] we learn that she is forbidden even though she was fit [for levirate marriage] at this falling, which we do not learn from the earlier clause, as [the Gemara] stated earlier (Yevamot 30a), nevertheless, since she was disassociated from this household completely, it is obvious that she is forbidden even though she was fit at this falling. And earlier, when [the Gemara] stated the reason of "she was fit at this falling" regarding this Mishnah, [it was] because it had not yet considered the reason that she was disassociated from this household.

Tosafot on Yevamot 32a:9:1.hebrew: שנשא חי ואח"כ נשא מת - אע"ג דבכי האי גוונא שרו ב"ש צרה לייבומי לעיל בפ"ק (יבמות דף ח.), דכיון דלא חייל איסור אשת אח, חשבי שלא במקום מצוה — ר"ש לית ליה האי סברא, דמכל מקום הרי היא אשת אחיו:
Tosafot on Yevamot 32a:9:1.english: Where the living [brother] married and afterward the deceased [brother] married - Even though in such a case Beit Shammai permit the co-wife to enter into levirate marriage earlier in the first chapter (Yevamot 8a), because since the prohibition of a brother's wife does not take effect, they consider [it] not in a place of a mitzvah — Rabbi Shimon does not hold this reasoning, for in any event she is his brother's wife.
